verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 9 285K is a desktop CPU, a hardware component that holds no user account or service data, so exporting your data in open formats and leaving is a category error for this product type. The 'heavy exports' marketing line refers to media rendering performance, not data portability, and nothing in the pack shows the product ships a data-export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
